DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アプリの表示でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the app display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入金通知が来ましたが、通知の時刻と明細の時刻が違います。別の入金ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知時刻と明細時刻の違いが別入金か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a deposit notification, but its time differs from the time in the transaction details. Are they separate deposits?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the different notification and transaction times mean separate deposits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ金額か、明細の内容を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you check whether the amount is the same and look at the transaction details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通知も明細も二万円です。明細には勤務先の名前があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同額と明細の勤務先名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both the notification and the details say 20,000 yen. My employer's name is in the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the matching amount and your employer's name in the details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知を送った時刻と、取引が記録された時刻は別に表示されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The time the notification was sent and the time the transaction was recorded are displayed separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時刻だけで二回入ったと思わない方がよいのですね。今日の入金は明細で一件です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知と取引時刻を区別し明細一件と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should not assume it came in twice just from the times. Today's deposits show as one entry in the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the notification and transaction times and confirm one entry in the details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。取引の件数はこちらの明細でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please check the number of transactions in these details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通知は消しても、明細の記録は残りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知削除が取引記録に影響するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I delete the notification, will the transaction record remain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether deleting the notification affects the transaction record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知を消しても、取引の記録は消えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Deleting a notification does not delete the transaction record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明細の一件を確認しました。通知を整理して、勤務先には二万円を受け取ったと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 明細を確認して通知整理と勤務先への受領連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed the one entry. I will organize the notifications and tell my employer I received 20,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the details and decide to organize notifications and tell your employer the money was received. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ほかにご質問がなければ、これで失礼します。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: If you have no further questions, I will leave it there. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to heat your boxed meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会計は終わっています。あの電子レンジを使っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計済み弁当の電子レンジ使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have finished paying. May I use that microwave?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to use the microwave for your paid-for boxed meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お使いいただけます。温め方の表示はお弁当にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may. Does the meal have heating instructions on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五百ワットで二分とあります。このレンジも五百ワットにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示の加熱条件と機械の出力を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says two minutes at five hundred watts. Can this microwave also be set to five hundred watts?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the stated heating conditions and the machine's power setting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらのボタンで選べます。ふたの扱いも、表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can choose it with this button. Please also check the instructions about the lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し開けると書いてあります。添えてあるソースは外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ふたを少し開けソースを外すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says to open it a little. I will remove the sauce that comes with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will open the lid slightly and remove the sauce. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。外したソースと箸は、横の台に置けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You can put the sauce you removed and the chopsticks on the table beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこに置いて温めます。終わったら、食事用の席へ持っていっていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 温め後の飲食スペース利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put them there and heat it. Afterward, may I take it to the dining seats?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about using the eating area after heating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。飲食スペースは奥です。熱い容器は両手でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The eating area is at the back. Please carry the hot container with both hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 温め終わりました。ソースと箸も忘れずに持って、奥の席へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 加熱終了を伝え付属品を持って席へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It has finished heating. I will take the sauce and chopsticks without forgetting them and go to the seats at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say heating is complete and take the accompanying items to the seats. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time and enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ワンちゃんと散歩ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。長く伸びるリードを使っています。この道を歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 伸縮リードの犬と歩ける道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am using an extendable lead. May we walk along this path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a path you can walk with a dog on an extendable lead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この道は散歩できます。人が通るところでは短く持ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can walk on this path. Keep the lead short where people pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今、一メートルくらいに縮めます。犬を自由に走らせる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リードを縮め自由運動できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will shorten it to about a meter now. Is there a place where the dog can run freely?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Shorten the lead and ask for a place for free exercise. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 柵のある運動区画がありますが、今日は整備で閉まっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a fenced exercise area, but it is closed for maintenance today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は道だけにします。芝生にも入っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運動区画の閉鎖を受け道を選び芝生利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will just use the path today. May we go onto the grass too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the path because the exercise area is closed and ask about the grass. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手前の芝生は入れます。奥の運動場は犬を連れて入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the grass nearer here. Dogs are not allowed on the sports ground further back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手前で少し休みます。犬の袋を捨てる箱はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 許可芝生で休むと決め犬の袋の処分を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will rest a little on the near side. Is there a bin for the dog's waste bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to rest on the permitted grass and ask how to dispose of the dog's bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 犬のごみは持ち帰っていただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We ask you to take dog waste home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋は自分の鞄に入れます。リードを短くして、手前の芝生まで歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋持帰りと短いリードでの経路を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the bag in my own bag. I will keep the lead short and walk to the nearer grass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the bag home and follow the route on a short lead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。散歩をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ロッカーに入らないお荷物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your luggage too large for the lockers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この楽器のケースです。二時間ほど預けたいのですが、窓口で扱っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ロッカーに入らない楽器を二時間預けたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is this instrument case. I would like to leave it for about two hours. Do you handle that at a counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to leave an instrument too large for a locker for two hours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手荷物の預かり窓口があります。中は楽器だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a luggage storage counter. Is there only an instrument inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。壊れやすいので、ケースを縦に置かないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身を説明し横置きを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It is fragile, so I would like you not to stand the case upright.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the contents and ask for horizontal storage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 預かり担当へ、その置き方をお伝えください。大きさで料金が変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the storage staff how you would like it placed. The charge varies by size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長さは九十センチです。取っ手の横に名前の札を付けてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長さと名前札の位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is ninety centimeters long. I have attached a name tag beside the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the length and the position of the name tag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が測ります。二時間後ですと、受付終了前に戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will measure it. In two hours you can return before reception closes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻ったときは、同じ窓口で受け取ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取窓口が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I come back, should I collect it at the same counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the collection counter is the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。預かり券をお持ちください。券の番号で照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Bring the storage ticket. We will match the number on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当に横置きを頼みます。預かり券を受け取り、二時間後に同じ窓口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当への置き方指定と預かり券での受取を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the staff to keep it horizontal. I will take the storage ticket and return to the same counter in two hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify how to place it and decide to collect it using the storage ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 窓口は右奥です。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The counter is at the back on the right. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 選挙の案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for election information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 投票日は出張なので、先に投票する場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出張前に投票できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will be away on business on election day, so I would like to know where to vote beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to vote before your business trip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 期日前投票の会場と日程の案内があります。入場券は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have information on early-voting venues and dates. Have you received your admission card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 届いています。仕事が終わったあとに行ける会場を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入場券所持を答え仕事後の会場を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have. I would like to see a venue I can go to after work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have the admission card and look for a venue after work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この表に、会場ごとの終了時刻が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This table lists the closing times for each venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この会場なら七時に行けます。持参するものは入場券だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 七時の来場を考え持ち物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can get to this one at seven. Is the admission card the only thing to bring?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider arriving at seven and ask what to bring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付での確認は選挙の担当が説明します。こちらに持ち物の案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Election staff will explain the checks at reception. There is information here on what to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内をもらいます。以前の住所の入場券なら、担当に相談が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所の入場券と転居について担当相談を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take this information. If my admission card has my previous address, do I need to consult the staff?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about consulting the staff over the old address on the admission card and your move. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所に関する判断は、選挙の担当へご確認ください。今のお話も引き継げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with election staff about any decision relating to your address. I can pass on what you told me too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 転居した日と入場券を担当に見せます。投票できる会場を確認してから、日を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転居日と券で担当判断を受けて来場日を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show them the date I moved and the admission card. After checking which venue I can vote at, I will choose a day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have staff assess the move date and card, then decide a visiting day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、選挙の担当へどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the election staff. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察での説明について、何かご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any requests about the explanations during your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語が難しいので、通訳アプリを使いたいです。診察室でも使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳アプリの診察室利用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Japanese is difficult for me, so I would like to use an interpreting app. May I use it in the consultation room too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using an interpreting app in the consultation room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 医師に利用の希望を伝えます。画面で見せる方法ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the doctor your request. Would you show it on the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。症状を入力した画面を見せます。診察の音声を録音するつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面提示を希望し録音はしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will show the screen where I entered my symptoms. I do not intend to record the consultation audio.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to show the screen and say you will not record audio. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。入力した文章も、医師と内容を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Please check the content of the entered sentences with the doctor too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この文章では、痛みが昨日からと出ています。本当は先週からなので、直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翻訳文の発症時期の誤りを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This sentence says the pain started yesterday. It actually started last week, so I would like to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the incorrect onset time in the translated sentence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先週からですね。いつ始まったか、診察でも口頭で補ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Since last week, then. Please also explain verbally during the consultation when it started.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付を入れ直しました。薬の名前は、翻訳せずに写真を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日付を修正し薬は写真で示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have entered the date again. I will show a photograph of the medicine instead of translating its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you corrected the date and will show the medicine in a photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 薬の写真も拝見できるよう、用意しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please have the medicine photograph ready for us to see too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの画面を開いておきます。分からない説明は、短く区切って話してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二画面を準備し短く区切った説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep both screens open. For explanations I do not understand, I would like the doctor to speak in short sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare both screens and ask for explanations in short sections. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望も医師へ伝えます。では、診察室へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the doctor that request too. Please go into the consultation room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通学路のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss the school route, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝、横断歩道で車がなかなか止まらず、子どもが渡れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝の横断歩道で子どもが渡れない状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: In the morning, cars take a long time to stop at the pedestrian crossing, and children cannot cross.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that children cannot cross at the pedestrian crossing in the morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the location and time of day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小学校の東門へ向かう交差点です。朝七時半から八時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東門への交差点と時間帯を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The intersection leading to the primary school's east gate. Between half past seven and eight in the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the intersection to the east gate and the time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 信号はありますか。見通しはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there traffic lights? How is visibility?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 信号はありません。坂の下なので、近づく車が見えにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 信号なしと坂による見通しを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are no lights. It is at the bottom of a hill, so approaching cars are hard to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the lack of lights and visibility due to the hill. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図で位置を確認しましょう。学校にも状況を伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the location on the map. Have you told the school too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先生に話しました。警察にも伝えてほしいと言われたので、来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 学校へ相談済みで警察への相談を勧められたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told a teacher. They asked me to tell the police too, so I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have consulted the school and were advised to consult the police. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 朝の状況を担当へ共有します。見守り活動の相談先もお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will share the morning situation with the staff in charge. We can also give you a contact for discussing safety watch activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談先をください。学校と時間帯を合わせて、見守りについて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見守りの相談先を求め学校と調整すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please give me the contact. I will coordinate the time with the school and discuss safety watch activities.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the safety-watch contact and decide to coordinate with the school. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お知らせいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受け取りの場所についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about where to collect a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼間は家にいないので、この郵便局で荷物を受け取りたいです。差出人にはどう伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 局での荷物受取を希望し差出人への伝え方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am not at home during the day, so I would like to collect my parcel at this post office. How should I tell the sender?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to collect a parcel at the post office and how to tell the sender. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 局留めの書き方をご案内できます。こちらの郵便局名を指定するのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can show you how to address it for post-office collection. You are specifying this post office, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この局です。局の住所だけでなく、私の名前も書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象局と受取人名の記載を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this one. They should write not only the post office address but my name too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the post office and writing the recipient's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人のお名前をお書きください。こちらに宛名の見本があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write the recipient's name. There is an address example here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見本を一枚ください。電話番号は私のものを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名見本を求め本人の電話番号を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please give me a copy of the example. I will give them my own telephone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an address example and say you will use your own telephone number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受け取りには、ご本人確認の書類をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When collecting it, please bring documents to verify your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届いたかを見に来る前に、番号で調べられる送り方を頼んでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着確認用に追跡できる発送を頼むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before coming to see whether it arrived, I will ask for a shipping method I can check with a number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to ask for trackable shipping to check arrival. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人に追跡できる方法と番号の連絡を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss a trackable method and sending you the number with the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見本を送って、届くまで番号を控えます。受け取りには本人確認書類を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本送付と番号保管と本人確認書類持参を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will send the example and keep the number until it arrives. I will bring identification when collecting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to send the example, keep the number, and bring identification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ご案内は以上です。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. That completes the information. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会社へ出す口座の用紙ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the bank-account form to submit to your company, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。支店名の欄と店番号の欄があり、通帳のどこを写すか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先書式の支店名と店番号の転記元を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There are fields for the branch name and branch number, and I am unsure where in the passbook to copy them from.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to copy the branch name and number for the employer's form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このページに、支店名と三桁の店番号があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This page has the branch name and the three-digit branch number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支店名は漢字で写します。店番号の最初のゼロも入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漢字支店名と先頭ゼロを含む店番号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will copy the branch name in kanji. Do I include the zero at the beginning of the branch number too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the kanji branch name and branch number including the leading zero. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。三桁すべてをご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please enter all three digits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書けました。口座の種類は、普通と書いてあるところを写せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記入完了を伝え口座種類の転記を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written it. For account type, should I copy the part that says ordinary?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have completed the entry and ask about copying the account type. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。口座番号とは別の欄に書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is right. Write it in a different field from the account number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普通と書きました。ここには残高を書く欄はないので、残高のページは会社に渡しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 普通を記入し残高ページを渡さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote ordinary. There is no field for the balance here, so I will not give the balance page to the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write ordinary and say you will not provide the balance page. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出先の指定に合わせてください。この用紙には口座を指定する項目がそろっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the recipient's requirements. This form has all the fields for specifying an account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 支店名、三桁、普通、口座番号を見直しました。通帳を閉じて、この用紙を会社へ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四項目を照合し記入用紙を提出すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the branch name, three digits, ordinary, and account number. I will close the passbook and submit this form to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the four fields and decide to submit the completed form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙をお忘れなく。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not forget the form. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取り置きのお米を受け取りにいらしたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have come to collect the rice we held for you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。十キロを二袋です。車まで運ぶ台車を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十キロ米二袋の台車貸出を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Two ten-kilogram bags. Could I borrow a cart to take them to my car?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow a cart for two ten-kilogram bags of rice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: サービスカウンターの台車を使えます。お車はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use a cart from the service counter. Where is your car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 建物の裏の駐車場です。重いので、二袋を一度に載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車の場所と二袋同時運搬を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the car park behind the building. They are heavy, so I would like to load both bags at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the car's location and carrying both bags together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この台車なら載せられます。積むときはこちらでお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This cart can hold them. We will help load them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。先に会計してから、出口で載せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計後の出口での積込みを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: That helps. After I pay first, could you load them at the exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for loading at the exit after paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。レシートを出口の係員へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Show your receipt to the staff member at the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 支払いが終わりました。台車は車からここへ返すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払い完了を伝え台車返却先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have finished paying. Should I return the cart here from my car?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say payment is complete and ask where to return the cart. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口の台車置場へ戻してください。空の台車でお戻りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please return it to the cart area at the exit. You may come back with the empty cart.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出口の係員にレシートを見せます。二袋を車へ運んで、台車を置場へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシート提示と車への運搬と台車返却を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the staff at the exit my receipt. I will take both bags to the car and return the cart to its area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to show the receipt, carry the bags to the car, and return the cart. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけてお運びください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care while carrying them. Thank you.
